modules.title: 一个 URL 怎样变成分享卡
Open Graph 字段怎样影响预览

items.title: 四个基础结果要能对应
items.text: og:title、og:description、og:image 和 og:url 分别提供标题、摘要、图片和地址。图片要能被分享平台从公开地址读取，不能只在本机或登录后可见。

items.title: 分享平台可能保留旧抓取结果
items.text: 修改后要重新请求或刷新平台的预览，再检查真实卡片。网页源码正确只能证明页面输出了字段，不代表平台已经更新缓存。

modules.title: 它不等于 SEO 或网页图片
modules.text: {c:open-graph} 专注于外部链接预览；{c:seo} 是更大的搜索呈现主题；{c:image} 是页面或资源中的图片。网页 Hero 图加载正常，不会自动证明分享卡的 og:image 正确。

lessonPractice.title: 文章页的 Hero 图在网页中正常，但分享卡没有图片，应该修什么？

options.label: 补或修正 og:image，使用外部可访问的绝对地址，再重新抓取预览
options.feedback: 对。网页中的 Hero 图和分享卡输入是不同路径，必须检查 og:image 的值与外部可访问性。

options.label: 继续裁切网页 Hero 图，直到分享平台自动发现它
options.feedback: 裁切页面图片不会自动写入 Open Graph 元数据，也不能保证外部平台读取到它。

options.label: 只增加正文关键词，因为 Open Graph 只负责搜索排名
options.feedback: Open Graph 主要描述链接分享预览，不是搜索排名配置；正文关键词不能替代 og:image。

en.title: The article Hero image works on the page, but the shared card has no image. What should be fixed?

options.label: Add or fix og:image with an externally reachable absolute URL, then refresh the preview fetch
options.feedback: Correct. The page Hero image and share-card input are separate paths, so inspect the og:image value and reachability.

options.label: Keep cropping the page Hero image until the sharing platform discovers it automatically
options.feedback: Cropping the page image does not write Open Graph metadata or guarantee that the external platform reads it.

options.label: Only add body keywords because Open Graph is for search ranking
options.feedback: Open Graph primarily describes shared-link previews, not search ranking; body keywords cannot replace og:image.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请为文章页补齐 Open Graph 的标题、摘要、绝对图片地址和规范 URL。不要把网页 Hero 图当作已完成证明；用外部分享预览验证标题、摘要和图片，并记录平台缓存导致旧结果时的证据。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Add the article's Open Graph title, description, absolute image URL, and canonical URL. Do not treat the page Hero image as proof; verify the title, description, and image in an external share preview, and record evidence if platform caching keeps an old result.

learning.assumes: You have seen a link preview in a chat or found that a shared link showed only a bare URL.
learning.outcome: You can map a share card's title, description, image, and URL to Open Graph fields and verify them in an external preview rather than only a page screenshot.

modules.title: How one URL becomes a share card
How Open Graph fields affect a preview

items.title: Four basic outputs should map cleanly
items.text: og:title, og:description, og:image, and og:url provide the title, description, image, and address. The image must be readable from a public URL by the sharing platform, not only on a local machine or behind a login.

items.title: The platform may keep an old fetch
items.text: After changing fields, request or refresh the platform preview and inspect the real card. Correct page source proves the fields were emitted, not that a cached preview has updated.

modules.title: It is not SEO or a page image
modules.text: {c:open-graph} focuses on external link previews; {c:seo} is the broader search-presentation topic; an {c:image} is the image shown in a page or asset. A working Hero image does not prove that og:image is correct.

distinctions.label: Page metadata
distinctions.text: {c:open-graph} is the share-focused group within {c:page-metadata}; page metadata also covers tabs, search, and installation consumers.

distinctions.label: Image
distinctions.text: {c:open-graph} says which image a share card should use; {c:image} owns the image's page display, ratio, and loading result.
